description: Hospitals, health centres and bed numbers in Jordan is a series of data sets listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Health. The number of treatments by the doctor in health centers classified by health areas, gender and age groups for the year 2020. Coverage: Jordan. The portal lists 22 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Health. Its tags are treatments. It offers 1 resource(s) in XML. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Jordonian License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support health-facility access and emergency-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
